Name: Back to the Valley Music Addon
Author: Grenades2go
Description:
This is a Content Patcher Content pack.
Prerequisite mods are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and the [url=https://smapi.io/]Stardew Modding API[/url].
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kJ9rV0Z/back-to-the-valley-cover-1.png[/img]
﻿
[size=6][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11517?tab=description]Back to the Valley[/url]  is a Music pack that features 12 songs
Made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/JaredAlexanderJohnson?gameId=1303]Jared Alexander Johnson[/url]﻿.
[/b][/size][size=3]All music was composed and recorded faithfully in the style of the Stardew Valley OST using the same samples and plugins.
All credit goes to him. I am not the original author.
[/size][size=6][b]
This is a music addon, so nothing is replaced in the base game.

3 new tracks per season
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MVjfsc4/back-to-the-valley-panel-2.png[/img]
[/b][/size][size=4]Each track is properly named and even added to the Jukebox for easy listening! (With credit to music author, easy to identify as a result.)[/size]
